routed_memory_observations.content: WHK: no operating financial statements filed as of 2026-08-04; treat as evidence_blocked until the first 10-Q or Internalization pro forma financials appear, or until the 424B4 prospectus is added to the evidence folder.

WHK: IPO'd 2026-06-10 on NYSE at $26.00/share (7,700,000 Class A shares; ~$200.2M gross proceeds); internally managed at listing via a $130.0M Internalization (75% paid at closing in 3,750,000 OpCo units/Class B shares, 25% earnout up to 1,250,000 more units/shares on Adjusted EBITDA targets over three Earnout Years); Series D preferred redeemed for ~$39.9M; revolving credit facility amended with Capital One as administrative agent (8-K, 2026-06-10).

- WHK 424B4 (filed 2026-06-09) confirms WhiteHawk Minerals Corp. is a natural gas mineral and royalty company (non-operated interests, Marcellus + Haynesville Shales) grown via the PHX Minerals (closed 2025-06-23) and Three Rivers Royalty acquisitions. Fully diluted share count at IPO close: 22,996,579 Class A + 3,750,000 Class B = 26,338,633 as-converted (pre-earnout of up to 1,250,000 more shares). Pro forma (2026-03-31, post-IPO): cash $10.5M, debt $75.0M, total assets $490.3M, total liabilities $115.0M. Pro forma FY2025: revenue $89.2M, Adjusted EBITDA $64.4M, Cash Available for Distribution $36.3M ($1.38/share, ~5.3% of the $26.16 price if a 100% payout ratio were assumed, which has not been declared).
- WHK restated its FY2025 audited financial statements on 2026-04-22, seven weeks before its 2026-06-10 IPO, for material accounting errors (management-fee recording; misclassification of acquisition-related cash) and identified material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting. No dividend or distribution has been declared as a public company as of 2026-08-05. [HUMAN REVIEW] before promoting any moat/quality or dhando conclusion.
